{{Quote|It is a legend among my people that at the very dawn of their age, the first of the Jedi Knights came to Caamas to learn from us the moral use of their power."<br />"I don't doubt the legend is true.|[[Elegos A'Kla]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]|<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Hespecia Tik'kla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] and lawgiver who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Promoting justice and fair-mindedness, Tik'kla's teachings were studied and adapted by the early [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], influencing the future teachings of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and setting the course for [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]].<ref name="TJP" />
